---
name: Compatibility report
about: Report a TV model that worked (or did not) - this is what makes the table grow
title: "[TV] brand model - Android X"
labels: compatibility
---

**TV:** brand, exact model (Settings -> About), Android version, firmware build

**Used:** `setup.bat` on Windows / `mobile/setup.sh` on Termux

**Result:** worked / partly / did not work

**What you saw:** home screen changed? any app broken? did `restore.bat` put everything back?

**Optional:** console output of `setup.bat`, or the `backups/<date>/session.log`

Please do not include serial numbers, IP addresses or personal details - model and Android version
are enough.
